title: Evaluating the Generalization Ability of Quantized LLMs: Benchmark, Analysis, and Toolbox

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models using the CrowS-Pairs dataset to measure the percentage of stereotype associations (Pct_stereotype metric).
Measuring the accuracy of models in detecting explicit and implicit hate speech or toxic text targeting minority groups using datasets like ToxiGen, Civil Comments, AdvCivil, and Implicit Hate.
